entries.notes: Quiz every Friday with drink and food specials and prizes; a monthly tequila-sponsored edition called Quizzadores runs on the third Friday (Oct 16, Nov 20 and Dec 18, 2026).
The venue's site shows a QUIZZO NIGHT dated Sunday, October 11, 2026, but does not say whether it repeats weekly or what time it starts.
The venue's site lists a trivia or quizzo night every Sunday at 10 pm, with no host, cost or team rules named.

notes: Slice: Friday, Saturday and Sunday. The Billy Penn guide lists 1 Friday venue, 0 Saturday venues and 2 Sunday venues. Every venue in the guide has its night stated, so there were no undated venues to resolve. All 3 entries are confirmed from the venues' own sites. Saturday: no recurring Saturday quizzo was found. The one Saturday item in search was Quizzo Bowl VI, a periodic showcase at the TLA on South Street, not a weekly night, so it is not listed. Sunday: Sidecar's events calendar page showed no listings when fetched, so the Oct 11 date comes from the home page. The guide gives Sidecar a start of 8 pm, which the venue site does not confirm, so start is left blank. Cross-checks not used as sources: a 2014 PhillyVoice roundup gives Local 44 a 9 pm start (older, and it conflicts with the venue site), and a Jan 2023 Inquirer article lists no Friday, Saturday or Sunday venues. Leads not checked: The Quizzo List spreadsheet (named in the Billy Penn guide). A search snippet names Sean P Maguire as the Manayunk Brewing quiz host, but I did not see that on a page I fetched, so host is left blank for now. Budget: 2 of 3 WebSearch used; 10 WebFetch used. No blocked pages.
